title: Umbrella
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- canopy: alternating bright panels -->
    <path d='M10 48 C 10 20, 90 20, 90 48 Q 80 42 70 48 Q 60 42 50 48 Q 40 42 30 48 Q 20 42 10 48 Z' fill='#ff5a7a'/>
    <path d='M10 48 Q 20 42 30 48 Q 40 42 50 48 L 50 22 Q 30 22 10 48 Z' fill='#ffd23f'/>
    <path d='M50 48 Q 60 42 70 48 Q 80 42 90 48 Q 70 22 50 22 Z' fill='#ffd23f'/>
    <path d='M50 22 Q 62 24 70 48 L 50 48 Z' fill='#ff5a7a'/>
    <path d='M50 22 Q 38 24 30 48 L 50 48 Z' fill='#3fd0ff'/>
    <!-- scallops again with brighter tips -->
    <circle cx='20' cy='47' r='2.5' fill='#ffd23f'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='47' r='2.5' fill='#ffd23f'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='47' r='2.5' fill='#ffd23f'/>
    <circle cx='80' cy='47' r='2.5' fill='#ffd23f'/>
    <!-- top knob -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='3.5' fill='#ffd23f'/>
    <!-- shaft -->
    <rect x='47.5' y='48' width='5' height='34' rx='2.5' fill='#b0703a'/>
    <rect x='48.5' y='48' width='1.5' height='34' fill='#e0a060'/>
    <!-- handle: hook -->
    <path d='M50 82 Q 50 92 38 92 Q 30 92 30 85' fill='none' stroke='#b0703a' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M50 82 Q 50 90 38 90 Q 32 90 32 85' fill='none' stroke='#e0a060' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
